comment: P6-A02 frozen Core path allowlist. Single source of truth for the Vite dev proxy and the standalone static server. Admin surfaces (/v1/auth/keys, /v1/audit) are deliberately absent: the browser proxy must not be able to mint keys or read audit even if a token carried admin.
phase_note: P6-01 forwards GET only: the browser is same-origin, so no preflight is needed and OPTIONS is deliberately NOT forwarded (it reached Core in review and returned 405 with a real audit row, which made 'read-only proxy' untrue). Mutation paths are listed for the later P6-02/P6-03 PRs; the method allowlist is what gates them, and Core still enforces scopes and actor kind per request.
